items.a: Children of all ages are welcome. Kids under 13 must run with a parent, and a parent signs the waiver for every child who takes part.

items.q: Can I run with my dog?
items.a: Yes, in the 5K. Please bring a non-retractable leash and your own waste bags to keep the trail clean. For everyone's safety, children under 13 can't run with a pet, on a leash or not.

items.q: Is there something for kids who aren't running?
items.a: There is a play area with a self-supervised bounce house, and the mechanical bull may be back. It isn't an official childcare service, so please plan who is watching your kids while you're on the course.
Participants park in the Lake Placid Firehouse lot, near the starting line.

items.q: Will there be cups at the aid station?
items.a: No. To cut down on waste, the aid station and the finish line are cup-less. Please bring a reusable bottle or a hydration pack.

Awards go by age group. In the 10K the groups are Youth (up to 20), Open (21 to 45) and Masters (46 and up), and the non-binary category has no age groups. The 5K has its own groups, with and without dogs, listed on the sign-up page. Flowers go to the top three mothers in each division.
A portion of every registration helps look after the Adirondack Rail Trail, through the Adirondack Rail Trail Association. A portion of the 5K proceeds goes to the Tri-Lakes Humane Society.
